name: Alphabet Tiles
description: Chunky letter and number tiles, one per character of the text, laid out in rows on the plate. The letter is a flush inlay (or raised) in its own colour, with an optional inlaid border ring. Rounded square, circle, hexagon, scalloped or heart tiles with a rounded top edge, and optional pockets for 6 x 2 mm or 8 x 3 mm fridge magnets: glued into the back, or pushed into a sealed cavity through a slot in the top edge after printing, with no pause mid-print.
source: inspired by Printables "Magnetic Letters - Refrigerator Alphabet Magnets" (Kyle Falconer, 465 downloads) and Grandpa 3DPrints' customizable word-game wall tiles (1,039 downloads)
